name: Lark
long_description:
Lark helps distributors run leaner inventory and automate purchasing, order entry, and sales updates. Our agents work with their existing systems to forecast demand and recommend what to reorder, how much, and when.

We launched eight weeks ago and have grown from $0 to $21K MRR, growing 104% MoM.

We’re building toward a complete AI-native operating system for distributors, replacing ERPs with one system for inventory, purchasing, orders, sales, and finance. Teams will tailor Lark to their own workflows, business rules, and approval limits, so they can automate operations while staying in control.
one_liner: AI native operating system for distributors
